blocks.text: For Cheerful Homes owners Andrew and Aiko Amante, moving to Mabalacat opened the door to a more manageable and balanced life they never imagined possible. Before that move, they were dreading Monday mornings. Not because of the work ahead, but because of the goodbye that came with it. For the past year, Sunday nights meant packing bags, loading the car, and making the long, exhausting drive back to Baguio, leaving their restaurants and a piece of their peace of mind behind. “Every week, ganun na lang,” Andrew recalls, his voice carrying the weight of those memories. “Andito kami sa Pampanga for […]...
